capability: Boussinesq natural convection in a differentially heated cavity

quantity.name: average Nusselt number and midplane velocity trend

reference.source: de Vahl Davis (1983), International Journal for Numerical Methods in Fluids 3:249–264, DOI 10.1002/fld.1650030305
reference.derivation: The published Nu sequence is reproduced in the public AeroSim benchmark transcription: https://docs.aerosim.io/nassu/validation/thermal/01_differentially_heated_cavity/README.html#reference-and-acceptance
reference.confirmed_from: AeroSim transcription of de Vahl Davis Table values; primary DOI recorded above

tolerance.rationale: Declared from PLAN.md before the refinement solve; the cited benchmark transcription is recorded above.

convergence.note: Benchmark trend across Rayleigh numbers and mesh sizes; no formal order claimed.

convergence_caveat: TIGHTEST MARGIN IN THE SUITE: Nu 3.49% and midplane velocity 3.83% against a 4% tolerance. The Ra=1e6 sequence is monotone but has NOT plateaued -- 32: 16.11%, 64: 6.47%, 96: 4.32%, 128: 3.49%, which is roughly FIRST-order convergence, not the second order the discretization should give. 3.49% must therefore not be read as a converged value; it is the error at 128x128 and a finer mesh would still move it. The pass is genuine and the trend is toward the reference, but the headroom is 0.5 percentage points. Ra=1e5 is scored on only two meshes (6.89% -> 3.42%).
